sources: Wedge. rmxlinux Json/SkillData/sk_wpn_pistol_0008 (weapon skill 3, SkillPatchTable: spell_dmg_up, spell_dmg_up2, spell_dmg_up3, duration, duration2): cardAttributeModifier attrs 51-54 (Heat, Electric, Cryo, Nature DMG) +spell_dmg_up (stat panel, with skills 1 and 2: main attribute, Critical Rate); passiveEventActions (1) abilityEvent 30 (the wielder casts) + CheckSkillType [2] (battle) -> buff_wpn_pistol_0008 on the wielder (attrs 51-54 +spell_dmg_up2, `duration`); (2) abilityEvent 206 (the wielder applies a buff) + CheckOriginSkillType [2] (from a battle skill) + tag 1474064594 (Arts Reaction) -> buff_wpn_pistol_0008_extra_valid (attrs 51-54 +spell_dmg_up3, `duration2`). Both stackingType 1 with a priority key and maxStackCntKey max_stack, which the skill doesn't have (B2: no limit; a same-owner reapplication of one value is the same as a refresh). buff_wpn_pistol_0008_extra (an abilityEvent-102 copy), _cd and _icon: named by nothing (orphans); toggleBuffs buff_wpn_passive_spirit_01 (no file). "When the wielder casts a battle skill, the wielder gains Arts DMG Dealt +{spell_dmg_up2} for {duration}s. When the wielder's battle skill applies an Arts Reaction, the wielder gains Arts DMG Dealt +{spell_dmg_up3} for {duration2}s. The two effects apply separately." Batch-4 report docs/kit-batches/batch-4/chr_0017_yvonne.md rows W7-W10.
